title: Context tension -- measured opposing-effect pairs over a run's persisted influence map
description: A derived, read-only detector over one run's persisted clozn.context_answer_influence.v1 measurement (run['influence_map']). A tension record means exactly: two DISTINCT context spans each have a causally_supported link to the SAME answer span, and their measured effects are opposite (one supports, one suppresses). This is NOT a claim that the two source spans semantically contradict each other -- it is controlled intervention evidence that they pulled this one recorded answer span in opposite measured directions. Never 'conflict', never 'contradiction', never 'wrong_source'/'correct_source'. Only evidence_state=causally_supported links participate; neutral links and below-floor 'observed' links never produce a tension record, even when their signs would otherwise oppose. Absence of a detected tension is not proof the context was consistent -- it means no above-floor opposing pair was found for the examined answer span(s).

scope.description: 'whole_answer': no range was supplied -- every resolvable answer span was examined. 'answer_range': start/end scoped the search to answer spans overlapping [start, end).

basis_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact recorded answer text (run['response']) this query was resolved against. Present whenever that text is known, even when measurement itself is unavailable -- absent only when the answer text could not be read at all (e.g. redacted).

state.description: Identical vocabulary to clozn.influence-query.v1's measurement.state. 'not_measured': no influence map was ever attached, or it cannot be trusted at all. 'unavailable': a persisted artifact exists but it, or the recorded answer text needed to resolve the target, cannot honestly be used (status=unavailable, redacted text, or a stale/drifted answer hash). 'error': the persisted artifact itself recorded status=error. 'available': the measurement was consulted and reconciled with this run's CURRENT answer text -- tensions may still be empty, which is a distinct, honest finding from any non-available state, and is never narrated as 'the context was consistent'.

reason.description: A stable, machine-readable reason, taken from the persisted artifact's own error code when one exists. Present on every non-available state; absent when state=available.

method.description: An unchanged copy of the source artifact's method object, including its persistent honesty caveat. Never re-derived.

thresholds.description: An unchanged copy of the source artifact's thresholds object.

source_span_id.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id for this side's measured context span.

delta_nats.description: Copied verbatim from the source Link. Licenses a claim about this exact intervention on this exact recorded continuation only.

source_span_id.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id for this side's measured context span.

delta_nats.description: Copied verbatim from the source Link. Licenses a claim about this exact intervention on this exact recorded continuation only.

tension_id.description: A stable digest of (run_id, answer_span_id, supporting.source_span_id, suppressing.source_span_id). The same measured evidence always yields the same ID -- never a random UUID.

answer_span_id.description: Real clozn.text-span-addresses.v1 address_id for the SINGLE answer span both sides' links target.

native.description: Underlying influence-map native identifiers/indices, retained for traceability. Not the canonical public identity -- tension_id/answer_span_id/source_span_id are.

answer_spans_examined.description: How many measured, resolvable answer spans were in scope (the whole answer, or the overlapping subset when a range was supplied).

answer_spans_with_tension.description: Distinct answer spans that produced at least one tension pair, before limit is applied.

tension_pairs.description: Total opposing pairs found, BEFORE limit is applied. May exceed len(tensions) when the result was truncated.

returned_tension_pairs.description: len(tensions) -- how many of tension_pairs this response actually carries after limit.

distinct_source_spans.description: Distinct source_span_id values appearing across all tension pairs found (both sides), before limit.
